title: HostMix-TOO: code, trained models and public-cohort predictions for host attraction in tissue-of-origin classification
description:
Code, trained models and sample-level predictions for public cohorts accompanying the manuscript on host attraction in tissue-of-origin classification of metastatic biopsies and its reduction by host-tissue mixture augmentation (HostMix-TOO).

The archive is a snapshot of the project repository without its git history. Files that contain POG570 patient-level data are left out and listed with their SHA-256 in WITHHELD.tsv; the full history, which contains the internal preregistration commits, is available to editors and reviewers on request. No expression data are included.
